checklist: py-matplotlib is the tarball under test; every other py-* is the published release (needsInstall), no needsRepack

discovery.mjs: py-* found without PYTHONPATH in the flat npm /node_modules, one pnpm project, and pnpm 12 `pnpm add -g` (one project per package); a py-* built for wasix-python 3.14.2-13 is skipped and python -v names it; discover() cost logged

sidemods.mjs: numpy linalg + fft, pandas read_csv + groupby, scipy optimize + integrate, matplotlib Agg PNG, PIL open/resize/save, contourpy, kiwisolver, the pure-Python packages import; no PYTHONPATH

constrained.mjs (3.11.2-8, homescoop#197): py-kiwisolver's cert/matplotlib.mjs with this package: plt.subplots(2, 2, layout='constrained') with titles, y labels and a colorbar saves a PNG through ConstrainedLayoutEngine and moves the left column right of the default layout's. 3.11.2-7 pins py-kiwisolver 1.5.1-6, whose strength getters trap: rc 134 (NEGATIVE.md)

3.11.2-10 (homescoop#211 A5): built from the PyPI sdist (matplotlib-3.11.2.tar.gz, sha256 cec59631…) in CI with meson 1.9.1, matplotlib's own subprojects (FreeType 2.14.3, HarfBuzz 14.1.0, libraqm 0.10.5, SheenBidi 3.0.0, Qhull 8.0.2: pinned in recipe.yaml, checked against the wraps' source_hash, --wrap-mode=nodownload) and pybind11 3.0.1, against wasix-python 3.14.2-27; no repack. test/py-vs-sdist.mjs (ci): 291 of the 292 shipped .py files equal the sdist's lib/ byte for byte, matplotlib/_version.py is generated, and 3 sdist test files aren't in matplotlib's meson install list. The test suites' baseline images are left out, as in -9. Dependencies take py-numpy, py-contourpy, py-kiwisolver and py-pillow as ranges from their -34-wave releases; the pure ones at their -8/-3 releases

cert/notices.mjs: THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md names FreeType (FTL text), HarfBuzz, libraqm, SheenBidi, Qhull, Agg, pybind11 and the BaKoMa/DejaVu/STIX/Last Resort fonts with their licence texts, plus matplotlib's other LICENSE/ files (homescoop#743)

3.11.2-11 (homescoop#761, the cp315 wave; npm-tag python3.15): the 3.11.2-10 recipe for CPython 3.15: wasix-python 3.15.0-1, wasix-sysroot -38 with the sysroot's libc++ headers (phase B), sitecustomize get_paths/LIBPC as the other cp315 meson builds; discovery.mjs and sidemods.mjs run on the published cp315 set (numpy 2.5.4-1, pandas 3.0.6-1, scipy 1.18.1-2, contourpy 1.4.0-10, kiwisolver 1.5.1-10, pillow 13.0.0-1, cycler/fonttools/packaging/pyparsing -9); discovery.mjs imports no pytz (pandas 3 dropped it; wasix-python's shared sidemods.mjs still imports it, so py-pytz 2026.4.0-4 is installed); constrained.mjs on py-kiwisolver 1.5.1-10; test/py-vs-sdist.mjs

3.11.2-12 (homescoop#761, the fold): packages/py-matplotlib3.15 moved over packages/py-matplotlib after the python3.15 -> latest flip; no npm-tag, the recipe and package name lose the 3.15 suffix (package.json homescoop.recipe, repository.directory), so the revision moves on; same sources and build as 3.11.2-11; every spec as before; py-python-dateutil is pinned at 2.9.0-post0.4

3.11.2-13 (homescoop#1283, #1337): the pure-Python dependencies as ranges from their version-neutral builds (py-python-dateutil 2.9.0-post0.4 -> >=2.9.0-post0.5 <2.9.1, py-cycler 0.12.1-9 -> >=0.12.1-10 <0.12.2, py-fonttools 4.66.1-9 -> >=4.66.1-10 <4.66.2, py-packaging 26.3.0-9 -> >=26.3.0-10 <26.3.1, py-pyparsing 3.3.3-9 -> >=3.3.3-10 <3.3.4), so npm installs the current one of each and nests no second copy; same sources and build as 3.11.2-12; every spec as before
